[[Nicholas the Traveler]] | render = [[File:Seed Item.jpg|60px]] }} [[Alpine Seed]]s are carried by the [[plant]] [[creature]]s in the [[Shiverpeak Mountains]], and are hardy enough to take root and grow in that frigid climate. These seeds are prized by some [[collector]]s as a curiosity. == Acquisition == * [[Northern Shiverpeaks]] ** [[Juniper Bark]] ** [[Succulent Juniper]] * [[Southern Shiverpeaks]] ** Juniper Bark ** [[Pinesoul]] ''Drop and salvage research is ongoing, and can be found [[Talk:Alpine Seed#Drop research|here]].'' ===Farming=== ====[[Deldrimor Bowl]]==== [[Hungry Devourer]] [[spawn]]s Succulent Junipers that also [[drop]] Alpine Seeds in addition to the Succulent Juniper Meat quest items. ====[[Frozen Forest]]==== Start from either [[Iron Mines of Moladune (outpost)|Iron Mines of Moladune]] or [[Copperhammer Mines]]. You will encounter four random Pinesoul bosses and several [[Azure Shadow]] group spawns of three. [[:File:Alpine Seed Farming.jpg|Click here]] to see the path. ====[[Ice Caves of Sorrow]]==== The very beginning of this mission contains around ten [[Pinesoul]], along with a few groups of Ice Imps and Mursaat. Can be handled with a reduced group or solo to maximize drops. Groups of Ice Imps can be easily avoided if necessary. [https://wiki.guildwars.com/wiki/Talk:Alpine_Seed#Farming] == Collectors == {{:Bariel Darkroot/Collector}} {{:Kagan Treesplitter/Collector armor}} {{:Sadira Powell/Collector armor}} {{:Nicholas the Traveler/Collector|6th December 2010 and 2nd December 2013|Frozen Forest|2 [[Alpine Seed]]s}} == Notes == * This item is required by [[Imperial Chef Reun]] for his salad at the annual [[Canthan New Year]] festival. * The collector [[Bariel Darkroot]] trades 5 Alpine Seeds for items that sell for 125 {{gold}} to a merchant. This provides a return that is over three times more than just selling the trophies by themselves.
